title: Accumulate and release
summary: Model a buffer station as a state machine: load five boxes, hold them at a blade, and release one per button press.
scope: Tests give deterministic native POSIX host evidence on a simulated plant scene; they are not physical, hardware, HIL, or certification evidence.
objectives: Model a station as steps and transitions, one step for each thing the station does.
Choose between two next steps with transition conditions that exclude each other.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/BufferRelease.sfc.json, build the chart: IDLE, LOADING and WAIT to load five boxes, QUEUED to hold them, RELEASING, PASSING and COUNT to let one go, and FINISHED.
stages.checkpoint: Each step sets every output, so reading the active step tells you what the station does.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, walk the chart: the start press moves it from IDLE into the loading steps, which turn on the buffer and emit a box every two seconds.
stages.checkpoint: The blade holds the queue after the fifth box; each press of the release button lets exactly one box pass EyeRelease; after the fifth release Done turns on and Fault stays off.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then run: The starter loads boxes but never holds them or releases them one at a time; add the steps and transitions that count five boxes in, hold the blade, release one per press, and finish with Done.
stages.checkpoint: The visible scenario must pass with saved host evidence.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: Press Check. ZPLC runs your saved program against the scenario of this lesson, with the plant answering your outputs, and lists every assertion that failed. To watch the plant move, press Run (F5) and open the 3D view.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named buffer-release and contains {{assertions}} assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Watch the active step change in the chart view while the boxes queue at the blade and leave one at a time.
stages.checkpoint: The blade is down only while a box is released, one box passes per press, and Fault stays off.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: The chart shows the whole sequence; the transition conditions are the only way to move between steps, so a missing condition stops the station.
stages.checkpoint: It does not establish physical belt speed, sensor response, hardware timing, HIL, or certification.

hints.text: Count in a local variable with a P1 action, so it adds one each time the step is entered, and give the choice after the count two transitions: one when the count reached 5 and one when it did not.

Add a COUNT step after PASSING for the released boxes, and let its transitions wait a short step time so the new count is visible; leave the blade up (Hold TRUE) in every step except RELEASING and PASSING.

faultCases: The starter loads boxes but never holds them or releases them one at a time; add the steps and transitions that count five boxes in, hold the blade, release one per press, and finish with Done.
